name: Daruharidra / Indian Barberry / Berberis aristata

sections.description_of_plant:
Daruharidra (botanical name: Berberis aristata) is an erect, evergreen shrub that can grow up to 3.5 meters in height. It is a woody plant with yellow to brown bark from outside and with dark yellow bark inside. The bark is fully covered with three branched thorns, which are modified leaves in tufts of 5-8 and are simple with pinnate venation. Upper surface of the leaves are dark green and the lower surface of leaves are light green. Leaves of this plant are toothed, simple, sessile, and leathery in texture and are arranged radially. Flowers are stalked, yellow, complete and hermaphrodite. The flowers appear in the month of April-May. This plant is self-fertile and is pollinated by small insects. Fruits are ovoid and covered with bloom as in plum and color is aconite violet. The fruits of this herb are juicy, rich in nutrients and contain plenty of sugar. Seeds are 2-5 in number and vary in color from yellow to pink. 
 General Information 
 Berberis aristata herb is called Indian barberry or tree turmeric and it belongs to the family Berberidaceae. It has been used in the Ayurvedic medicine system for a long time. Fruit of this plant is an edible and rich source of vitamin C. The root bark of this herb is rich in berberine and isoquinoline alkaloids. Both chemical compounds are anti-fungal, anti-bacterial, anti-oxidant, anti-viral, ant-diabetic, anti-tumor and anti-inflammatory in nature. 

 Whole plant is a very good source of dye and is used for dyeing clothes, cotton and leathers. Roots of this herb is used in the preparation of alcoholic drinks. 
 Special Note about Berberis Aristata 
 Rasaunt is a special preparation made from the Daruharidra (Berberis aristata) plant. To prepare it, the root bark and lower stem are boiled in water—typically using sixteen times the amount of water compared to the weight of the plant material. The solution is then strained and further boiled until only one-fourth of the liquid remains. This concentrated extract is cooked again until a semi-solid mass forms. The resulting mass, known as Rasaunt, is traditionally mixed with substances like butter , lime juice , or opium juice , and is used as a mild purgative and to treat various ailments .
sections.habitat:
Daruharidra herb is native to Himalayas in India. It is also widely distributed in wet zone of Sri Lanka. This species of evergreen deciduous shrub is also found in temperate and sub-tropical regions of Asia, Europe and America. It is also distributed in Bhutan and hilly areas of Nepal. Daruharidra is also found in Himachal Pradesh especially in Kumaon and Chamba region. This herb is widely distributed in Nilgiris hills in South India. 
 Classification of Daruharidra 

 Kingdom – Plantae 
 Order – Ranunculales

sections.berberis_aristata_uses:
Paste of this herb is used externally to reduce pain and inflammation. Best use of this herb is in eye related disorders. 
 It is also used for quick healing of wounds and paste of this herb is also useful in syphilis, ulcers and anal fistula. 
 Daruharidra helps to cure spasmodic pain and is very beneficial for patients of menorrhagia and leucorrhoea. 
 Roots of daruharidra are hepato protective in nature and fight against liver toxicity. It gives wonderful result in jaundice patients. 
 It is also anti-diabetic in nature. Root powder of this herb triggers the extra formation of insulin and protect body from harmful effects of diabetes. 
 Daruharidra is very effective herb with anticancer properties which fights against human colon cancer. 
 This herb fights against the various infections caused by microbes in both males and females. In females it is used to cure uterine infections. 
 It is also used in ear aches and ear discharge. 
 This herb helps to stimulate sweating and is used in intermittent fever. It is much effective herb in malaria than any other herbs. 
 Fruit of this herb is appetizer, helps to stimulate digestive fire and is beneficial in patients of dysentery. 
 It is also used for constipation and piles. 
 Paste of this herb is applied over eyelids to reduce conjunctivitis. 
 Decoction of Daruharidra is used in the form of gargles in throat infections and to improve voice. 

 Representative and Adulteration 
 There is no special adulteration in it in North India, but in Bombay, wood of many types of plants is boiled in turmeric and sold. The stem of the Tree turmeric (Coscinium fenestratum Gaertn.) Colebr. is also given in its place.
